script.description: Self-contained workflow script (plain JavaScript, not TypeScript) starting with `export const meta = {...}`.

scriptPath.description: Path to a workflow script file on disk. Takes precedence over `script`.

args.description: Optional input value exposed to the script as the global `args`, verbatim. Pass arrays/objects as actual JSON values, NOT as a JSON-encoded string.

maxConcurrent.description: Maximum subagents running at once (default 16). Further agent() calls queue.

model.description: Default model handle or alias for subagents (see `letta model list`). Omit to inherit the invoking conversation's model; per-call opts.model overrides this.

allowedTools.description: Default tool allowlist for subagents (per-call opts.allowedTools overrides). Defaults to read-only: Read, Grep, Glob. Widen deliberately for workflows that must write.
